rationale: Full-branch review re-run against the final implementation. The four blocking findings from the earlier round are addressed: CR-001 (always-mounted live region in ResponseReadyAnnouncer.tsx), CR-003 (try/catch around showNotification() in markResponseReady, so a Notification constructor throw on mobile Chrome cannot escape stream completion), and CR-004 (session flag stops repeated permission prompts after a dismissal). CR-002 (an A2UI-only, text-less completion observed through polling does not signal ready) is an accepted gap by user decision: the empty-text guard in lastTurnFinishedWithResponse is what keeps a failed generation from signalling, the poll payload carries no terminal-completion flag, and the stream path still signals on the terminal last chunk. No spec was supplied, so acceptance was skipped. No other findings.

business_review.item: Tab is signalled when a response completes while the document is hidden
business_review.notes: markResponseReady sets pending only when document.hidden; stream finalize, reconnect and poll paths all reach it.
ResponseReadyAnnouncer keeps the sr-only <output> mounted and fills 'AI response ready' only while pending (CR-001 fixed).

business_review.item: Feature must not disrupt streaming or error handling
business_review.notes: showNotification() is guarded by try/catch inside markResponseReady (CR-003 fixed); requestPermission rejections are caught.

business_review.item: Permission prompt does not interrupt on every submit
business_review.notes: notificationDeclinedThisSession short-circuits requestNotificationPermission after a dismissed or denied result (CR-004 fixed).

business_review.item: A2UI-only (text-less) completion via polling does not signal ready (CR-002, src/store/chats.ts)
business_review.notes: Accepted gap by user decision. The empty-text guard in lastTurnFinishedWithResponse separates a failed generation from a completed one because the poll payload has no completion flag; the gap is recorded by a comment in source and is not a regression.
